parsed.explanation: GE separated its former GE Vernova and GE HealthCare businesses, and the results—including cash and cash equivalents—were recast as discontinued operations for all periods presented on a retrospective basis. This caused the previously reported 2023 year-end cash balance to be restated to exclude cash held by those discontinued businesses.
parsed.evidence_quote: DISCONTINUED OPERATIONS primarily comprise our former GE Vernova and GE HealthCare businesses...Results of operations, financial position and cash flows for these businesses are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented and the notes to the financial statements have been adjusted on a retrospective basis.
